Like one of the invention by Aleksander Bell's called Telefon, which completely changed the lives of humans on this planet. Similarly, the cryptocurrency OneCoin appeared, which has been in Europe. Even today, OneCoin is the second strongest cryptocurrency in the world. The OneCoin was based on the very best cryptocurrency and as a result, hundreds of new billionaires started to appear in 4 years. Currently, OneCoin is rank of the fastest developing cryptocurrency in the world. During the first 12 months, it joined the millions of people project and over 65,000 partnerships, Onecoin decides to use the values offered. On average, around 4,000 active people register in a day, promoting this huge opportunity. Thousands of people earn more than than 5000 € a month. The project offers a unique financial program where for only 12 months about 400 people earn over 35 000 USD. The monthly turnover of 1Coin has already exceeded the value of 150 million €. Cryptocurrency is already traded in 190 countries around the world. There is a huge demand for this currency, especially in China, it is also very popular in India, although record holder is Juha Pachala from Finland. His income in OneCoin was classified as the second position among the most profitable people in the world in the MLM industry. He does not appear in the official market, but in the chart and is ranked at the 2nd position among the best-earning people in the world. It earns over 1.000.000 USD per month. Steyn Keller, with its $1.000.000 of money earned, has achieved great success. They now earn $550.000.00 a month and are ranked as 7th in the world's best-paid MLM competitors. The value for one OneCoin has increased from 10 EUR CENT to 2.5 EUR CENT in 2015. This is more than 2400% and it is still growing. In OneCoin there are 2 kinds of revenues. First, commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring. Second, profits resulting from the growth of the value of OneCoin, which its cost by the value of WTC. The first. It is the center of the internal global stock exchange. Dr. Rūzia Ignatowa is the founder, owner and director of WTC, and she has gained the title of law master in Oxford. Second the title of Master of Economics at the University in Constance. She is also the Doctor of Philosophy. She wrote the Master's Diploma in International Governance and she is a business partner of McKinsey and Company. She also worked with Texas Pacific Group, one of the biggest financial capital fund companies in the world. She was also a financial director of the biggest investment fund group in Bulgaria. Among them is already mentioned Juhap Aryala. OneCoin is currently the world's fastest growing cryptocurrency. So join us for the biggest financial revolution of this century.

textual.observation: The narration promotes OneCoin by linking claims of high monthly earnings and financial freedom to becoming a partner and joining the project.

evidence.quote: Thousands of people earn more than than 5000 € a month.
income and financial freedom.
As a partner of the Wealth Code, you will gain access to the support system
join the 650,000 partners.

textual.context: Presented as a promotional opportunity; no independent verification or explicit warning is supplied in these records.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links substantial income and financial-freedom claims with partner participation and joining the project, creating a reward-to-recruitment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the claimed earnings occurred, how payouts were calculated, or whether any viewer received them.

textual.observation: The source describes revenue from directly recommended customers and structuring, as well as profits from OneCoin value growth, in a partner and MLM context.

evidence.quote: In OneCoin there are 2 kinds of revenues.
commissioning for directly recommended customers and structuring.
profits resulting from the growth of the value of OneCoin
ranked as 7th in the world's best-paid MLM competitors.

textual.context: The narration presents these as described revenue mechanisms within the OneCoin opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised financial return is explicitly linked to recommending customers or structuring and to the claimed appreciation of OneCoin's value.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual customer enrollments, payment processing, realized profits, or the terms governing these revenue streams.

textual.observation: Viewers are asked to click a money-making prompt and submit their name, surname, and email to register, after which the narration says they become a partner and gain access to the Wealth Code.

evidence.quote: Click in the pol under the video. I want to make money.
You will be redirected to the entry registration, where you will only provide name & surname and address email address.
Thanks to the easy and free registration, you'll our partner and will gain access to a wealth code.

textual.context: The requested action is presented as a registration step for access to the promoted opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: The money-making promise is directly paired with clicking, submitting contact information, and partner enrollment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what happens after registration, how submitted information is handled, or whether any money-making outcome occurs.

textual.observation: The narration uses a join-now call alongside claimed rapid registration and a large partner count.

evidence.quote: around 4,000 active people register in a day, promoting this huge opportunity.
Get into the project now and join the 650,000 partners.
So join us for the biggest financial revolution of this century.

textual.context: The language is part of the promotional call to join the project.
textual.potential_relevance: An immediate join instruction is tied to claimed large-scale participation and a financial-opportunity pitch, creating an urgency and recruitment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish a deadline, scarcity condition, or independent confirmation of the stated registration rate or partner count.

visual.observation: An animated cryptocurrency-themed sequence shows the Polish text "Za 12 miesięcy" ("After 12 months") with a partially visible line beginning "400 partnerów, zarabia...", followed by a "Polecaj innym" ("Recommend to others") prompt next to a coin graphic and cursor.
visual.context: Promotional-style animated presentation; whether the partial earnings statement and recommendation prompt are part of one offer is unclear from sparse samples.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible sequence associates an earnings-related statement involving 400 partners with a prompt to recommend the offering to others, which conditionally merits review as a reward claim linked to recruitment.
visual.limitations: The earnings sentence is cut off, and the samples do not show any completed referral, compensation terms, payment, or outcome.

visual.observation: A registration interface visibly requests a name and email address and shows a "Rejestruj się" ("Register") button. A later screen says "Dołącz teraz do najszybciej rozwijającej się krypto waluty na świecie" ("Join now the fastest-growing cryptocurrency in the world") with a "Chcę zarabiać" ("I want to earn") button.
visual.context: Promotional-style animated interface; the frames do not show whether the registration form and join/earn screen are on the same destination.
visual.potential_relevance: A request to submit identifying contact information through registration appears alongside an invitation to join a cryptocurrency and earn, creating a conditional relationship between data submission and an earnings-oriented offer.
visual.limitations: No form submission, destination, payment step, eligibility terms, or actual earnings are visible; the apparent sequence does not establish a click or redirect.

textual_context_notes.observation: The records present the material as promotional and partner-recruitment content rather than as a neutral discussion.

textual_context_notes.observation: The ASR contains a potentially inconsistent or mistranscribed token-value statement; the intended meaning is unresolved.

evidence.quote: The value for one OneCoin has increased from 10 EUR CENT to 2.5 EUR CENT in 2015.
This is more than 2400% and it is still growing.

visual_context_notes.observation: A filmed interview scene includes Chinese subtitles stating: "Onecoin 是一种创新的加密货币，被称为下一个更好的比特币。"

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin with substantial income and financial-freedom claims tied to recommended customers and recruitment. It urges viewers to join partners, recommend others, provide their name and email, and use an earnings-oriented registration interface. Completed registration, payment, actual earnings, and data handling remain unverified, and the sampled Polish earnings statement is visibly incomplete.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted partner opportunity describes commissions from directly recommended customers and structure building, rather than only a standalone referral code.
